name: rosetta-combinations
code:
use default

choose(m: int, n: int, from: int, chosen: LIST[int]) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    if chosen.count == m then
        yield chosen

        return
    fi

    for candidate in from..n do
        let extended = LIST(chosen)

        extended.add(candidate)

        yield in choose(m, n, candidate + 1, extended)
    od
si

combinations(m: int, n: int) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] =>
    choose(m, n, 0, LIST())

for combination in combinations(3, 5) do
    write_line(combination |> join(" "))
od
